messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INC-4012 created by monitors/embeddings-queue - high p99 latency on embeddings-queue-prod in us-west-2. Pager sent to primary. Link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-4012

Alex Nguyen: quick handoff - I'm primary till 04:00 UTC, Maya is secondary and will take over at 03:30 UTC. Current state: ongoing elevated p99 for embeddings-generation (api/embeddings). Customers reporting slower search results, ~5% error spike on retries.

Alex Nguyen: What we've done so far:
- scaled embeddings dedicated pool +2 nodes (g4dn) in us-west-2
- enabled routing fallback to quantized-model-v2 for short requests (<=256 tokens)
- temporarily increased prefetch worker count for KV cache
- started a gradual traffic shift to eu-west-1 fallback for low-risk tenants (30% traffic)

Alex Nguyen: Observable impact: p99 reduced from ~1.8s -> ~1.25s for fallback traffic, but write errors to tokenstore increased slightly during scale (timeouts). No widespread data loss.

Sam Ortiz: added logs from the last 10m: `ERR tokenstore timeout 500ms` correlates with nodes being added. I think tokenstore client is retrying and causing head-of-line delays.

Alex Nguyen: confirmed. mitigation in progress: lowering tokenstore client timeout from 500ms -> 250ms for retries on the embedding path to avoid long blocking. Command we used:
```
kubectl -n redwood scale deploy embeddings-dedicated --replicas=6
# and
kubectl -n redwood set env deploy/edge-client TOKENSTORE_TIMEOUT_MS=250
```

Jordan Li: coverage note - APAC is short-staffed 02:00-06:00 UTC tonight, primary/secondary can handle but if we need a cross-region manual failover we might be delayed ~20-30m. flagging to incoming shift.

Maya Patel: oncoming - I'll take over at 03:30 UTC. Priorities for me on takeover: verify cache eviction rate, watch tokenstore 5xxs, validate routing fallback steady-state. Where is the runbook?

Alex Nguyen: runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.example/embeddings-queue#fallback-and-tokenstore. Quick checklist pasted below: 
1) Check `metrics:embeddings.queue.p99` and `alerts:INC-4012`
2) Confirm fallback routing at `routing-service/v2/overrides`
3) If tokenstore 5xx > 2% for 10m -> run `tokenstore-failover` in ops runbook and notify SRE lead

Maya Patel: got it. I'll verify routing overrides now.

Sam Ortiz: testing note - when we increased replicas, I saw brief OOMs on prefetch workers (logs: `prefetch worker killed: OOM`). I reduced prefetch parallelism to 4 which stopped crashes but may affect latency.

Alex Nguyen: thanks. that's why I bumped the prefetch workers earlier, then lowered parallelism. Tradeoff accepted for now to keep CPU stable.

oncall-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy detected on service `routing-service` by @automation at 6351239800. Action: monitor for increase in 5xx. Canary config: 5% traffic -> 60% ramp.

Maya Patel: I'll keep an eye on canary. If 5xxs spike >0.5% over baseline for 5m, pause and rollback. Command for rollback is `deployctl rollback routing-service --to canary-base`

Lia Gomez: customer-impact note: Support reported 3 customers with elevated latency affecting search autosuggest. CS is aware and has message template. If this becomes >10% of customers in a region escalate to comms.

Jordan Li: quick mitigation suggestion - consider enabling local prefix caching for the top 10 tenants (hot keys) to reduce KV hits. That can be toggled via `cache-toggle` in the admin console for tenant IDs.

Alex Nguyen: agreed, Sam - can you enable hot-key caching for tenants 117, 220, 341? Sam Ortiz: done for 117 and 220; 341 needs manual approval from the tenant owner, pinged them.

Maya Patel: takeover checklist - I will: 1) verify current scaling actions stabilized (replicas and prefetch), 2) watch tokenstore error rate, 3) monitor canary. I'll post a 15m status update after takeover.

Alex Nguyen: handoff note: all alerts are silenced to oncall-channel for 10m to reduce noise, but paging rules still active. If any page comes through please escalate immediately. My contact: @alex (Slack) or +1-555-0101.

Maya Patel: taking over now. Thanks Alex. If anything gets worse I will call the bridge and tag SRE lead. :thumbsup:

Lia Gomez: FYI ops play for escalation: if tokenstore 5xxs > 3% for 15m, open an incident commander tag and call the bridge code +1-800-OPS. Link: https://playbooks.redwood.example/escalation

Sam Ortiz: remaining TODOs for incoming: check `tokenstore` GC logs, confirm no pending docker image pulls blocking nodes, and verify circuit-breaker settings for fallback model.

Maya Patel: noted. I'll run checks and post back in 15 minutes.

Alex Nguyen: handing off control. If anyone needs context on the scale commands or the reason for the 250ms timeout, ping me. Handoff complete. :raised_hands:
